name: mcp-profiles
description: Portable, reusable operating systems for AI agents — a Model Context Protocol gateway that re-exposes downstream MCP tools according to the active profile.
author: Brian Sparker <brian@you.com>

scripts.gen:types: json2ts spec/profile.schema.json -o src/profile/types.ts --bannerComment "/* AUTO-GENERATED from spec/profile.schema.json — do not edit by hand. Run: npm run gen:types */"
scripts.inspect: npm run build && npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector node dist/index.js --profile growth-pm
